ensemble.rule: equal arithmetic mean of legal-action logits, greedy argmax

notes: All four frozen candidates reported, plus geographic teacher and all-reference controls; no best-seed replacement, fitting, qualification, or promotion.
All nonfocal players use the identical unchanged public FILTER service for ALL phases; candidate focal policies learn Auction/Building and use their pinned geographic fixed phases.
Fresh paired seeds and all focal seats; 80 independent deals, not 1920 independent observations. Four deals per cell is a small descriptive screen.
All-reference seat rotations must reproduce the same terminal credit vector and focal credits must sum to one per deal.

Errors and caps are explicit zero evaluation credit in the recorded-game denominator, never terminal rewards. Fail closed on errors or baseline inconsistencies; retain failures and do not retry them silently.
Only compact identity/plan, outcomes, coverage/statistics and status are persisted. No public requests, hidden states, action traces, trajectories or training fixtures are saved as new data.
Full frozen reference cache is hash-verified once per worker startup. Archived training/fixture bytes exist only to satisfy the exact loader, never as new training/evaluation data.
Smoke uses a distinct namespace, one 2-player original open-auction deal, both seats and all six policies (12 games), and is not part of this screen.
